detours.why: The Shands generator plant is reached only by a dead-end drive on its south side; no path crosses the lawn between it and the Diamond Village loop road, so walks go round by the main road.
IFAS service buildings across open, unpathed fields from Hume; the mapped way is the long loop out to the main road and back in.
Dickinson Hall is a 150 m building with its pin mid-footprint; the way in on the map is from the Museum Road side, across Newell Drive from Jennings.

infinity-hall.why: Infinity Hall is downtown (978 SW 2nd Ave). The places over 45 minutes are the far southwest and IFAS buildings, 2.5 to 3.6 km away in a straight line; each still faces the 2.5x rule.
